answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the harbor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The oasis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the relic.
